verdict.note: First measurement of this blind spot, taken because the hold work added click/double-click handlers to the very rows this scenario drags and selects. Real Chromium on the worktree dashboard against the live backend (reparent calls mocked at the HTTP boundary — no session was actually reparented): the child row's context menu entered selection, a second row toggled in for 2 picked rows with no navigation, cancel exited; the child dragged onto a valid parent showed ghost + drop-target and wrote {children:[child],parent:target}, the top-level drop zone lit and wrote parent:null, and a same-row no-op landing wrote nothing. Select mode still claims the click, so the new hold gestures do not fire while picking.
